Plot LHWR Model Surfaces

Source: R/plot_grammar.R
plot_lhwr_model.Rd

User-friendly wrapper around plot.lhwr() for coefficient, fitted-value, residual, and local R-squared maps.

Usage

plot_lhwr_model(
  object,
  type = c("coefficient", "se", "t_value", "fitted", "residual", "local_r2"),
  coefficient = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

An LHWR model object.

type

Model surface type: "coefficient", "se", "t_value", "fitted", "residual", or "local_r2".

coefficient

Coefficient name for coefficient-level surfaces.

...

Additional arguments passed to plot.lhwr().

Value

Invisibly returns object.

Examples

H <- simulate_H2(35, r_max = 2)
x <- rnorm(35)
y <- 1 + x + rnorm(35, sd = 0.2)
fit <- lhwr(y ~ x, data.frame(y, x), Z = H$Z, bw = 15, adaptive = TRUE)
plot_lhwr_model(fit, type = "coefficient", coefficient = "x")
